caption:
AI keeps writing in a style that is not yours? 😤 Stop describing it and SHOW it.

1️⃣ Paste one example of the style you like
2️⃣ Say: "Write the next one in this exact style"
3️⃣ Give it your new topic

One good example beats ten lines of instructions. 📌 Save this for your next prompt.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

#ai #chatgpt #claude #aitools #promptengineering #aitips #productivity #contentcreation #techtips #techmendly

scenes.sub: Stop describing your style. Show it.
scenes.say: Does AI never write like you? Stop describing your style. Show it.

scenes.title: Paste one example you like
scenes.body: A caption, an email, a post. Anything in your style.
scenes.say: One. Paste one example of the style you like. A caption, an email, anything that sounds like you.

scenes.title: Tell it what to do
scenes.code: Write the next one in this exact style.
scenes.say: Two. Tell it what to do. Write the next one in this exact style.

scenes.user: Example: Fresh bread, no rush. Come hungry. Now write one for my new coffee menu.
scenes.reply:
Fresh coffee, no rush.
Come thirsty. New menu is here.
scenes.say: Three. Give it your new topic. Now watch. The answer matches your style, because the AI had something real to copy.

right.title: Showing an example
right.text: Clear. The AI copies the pattern.

scenes.say: Describing your style is vague. Showing one example is clear. Show, do not tell.
